letter.title: For you, Hena
letter.body:
Dear Hena,

I don't know how to say all of this out loud, so I built you a small quiet corner of the internet instead.

Every time the world felt loud, thinking about you made it soft again. Your laugh, the way you scrunch your nose when you're focused, the way you make ordinary evenings feel like a memory in the making — I've kept every second of it, carefully, like petals pressed inside a book.

Today is your day. I hope it feels gentle. I hope you feel cherished. I hope the people around you get to see even a little of what I get to see in you.

Whatever this year brings, I want you to know: someone, somewhere, is quietly rooting for every dream of yours. Someone thinks the sky did a good job on October 23, 2008.

Happy birthday, Hena.
Be brave. Be soft. Be exactly you.

— Debjeet

finalMessage:
Some gifts are bought.
Some gifts are created with time, patience, and care.
This little website is one of them.

I hope today brings you happiness, smiles, and beautiful memories.

Happy Birthday.
